blocks.text: Filipino consumers can now enjoy premium Korean grapes following the official entry of Korean grapes into the Philippine market after 18 years of quarantine negotiations between Korea and the Philippines. To mark the milestone, the Korea Agro-Fisheries & Food Trade Corporation (aT) held the ‘Korean Premium Grape Launching Show’ on September 29 at Solaire Resort Entertainment City in Parañaque. The event brought together Korean grape producers and exporters, Philippine distributors, buyers, foodservice industry representatives, and influencers to introduce the quality, variety, and market potential of Korean grapes. Quarantine negotiations for the importation of Korean grapes into the Philippines had been ongoing […]...
